_about: Nisues (121159, vesta_caster): refers to herself in the third person. Translated from the game's Japanese. Global names/terms: the Vesta, Spirit Horns (心角; her title/skill keep the community's "Empathetic Horns" from units.json), Memram, Elmor (the "problem child"), Nicola, Shirano, Golem Club, Voluntas Arcane Arts Academy, Guild Knights, Stella, Alk, Light, Nimbus. オド is rendered as "aura".
profile: The first adventurer of the Vesta tribe in Palpebra's tradition. Using her Spirit Horns, which read people's emotions, she keeps harmony with those around her, while enjoying her first life outside the Vesta herself.
titleCondition: Level Nisues to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

speech.home/fufufu_komattakotoga: Hehehe. If you're ever in trouble, anything at all. As long as it's with everyone, Nisues can enjoy it.
speech.home/kokoroga_onajini: It's happy when hearts become one. Vesta and humans are the same...!
speech.home/besutanishite_bokensha: A Vesta, and an adventurer. Nisues is the one who connects the two. ...Hehe. Nisues has to do her best, doesn't she?
speech.home/shiruyorokobio: Nisues wants to share the joy of learning with everyone. Please keep taking care of Nisues!
speech.home/odogasukoshi: Lady Memram was pleased that Nisues's aura changed a little... Has Nisues changed?
speech.home/nisuesunoshiranaikoto: Things Nisues didn't know, things auras can't tell you. The world had so many of them. That's-- fun, and it makes Nisues happy!
speech.ally/join: Nisues, Staff of the Vesta. From now on, as an adventurer, Nisues will do her utmost for everyone's fun future.
speech.ally/evolution: Just touching happy auras was enough to make Nisues happy. ...But when Nisues touches something new, her heart sways... Is this what "fun" is...?

1.title: Daughter of the Vesta
1.summary: Alk and the others take on a delivery request with Nisues, a Vesta girl who became an adventurer to gauge the relationship between humans and the Vesta. On the way back, Nisues saves a wounded adventurer and devotes herself to helping others, making her way through the outside world toward the "things she loves" she has yet to discover.

lines.9: Exactly, Champion. This time it is an official matter, accompanied by a pact.
lines.12: To discern the relationship between humans and the Vesta.
lines.22: Nisues is the Staff of the Vesta. Nisues will do her utmost for the future.
lines.26: Nisues is not like that problem child. She is worthy of carrying this duty.
lines.31: ...So you want to be involved with adventurers too, not just the Guild Knights? Yeah. If that's the case--
lines.36: Yes. Welcome to Starview Village, Nisues.
lines.41: Nisues is happy. Please take care of Nisues.
lines.46: Likewise. So, right off the bat, want to look at some requests?
lines.50: Yes. Nisues heard the explanation. But she wanted to experience it for real--
lines.54: Right now there's a delivery to a nearby village... escorting a transport caravan... that's for big groups. And... a large monster hunt, huh...
lines.61: While doing adventurer work, Nisues can learn the lay of the land here too.
lines.66: Right. Yeah, if that's the idea, it's just right.
lines.70: This is Nisues's first adventure. She's excited...!
lines.84: Good call. The Vesta's teamwork really is something else...
lines.93: There. Your wound is healed now.
lines.98: Thanks, Nisues. ...But that's amazing. I didn't even notice it myself--
lines.106: An aura of pain... Over there...!
lines.112: Hang in there...! Can you hear Nisues's voice...?
lines.118: Thank goodness... It doesn't hurt anymore, right?
lines.128: Nisues is going back to the Guild. What about you? Are you an adventurer too?
lines.131: Y-yeah... I was... heading for the Guild too--
lines.134: Nisues...! Is he gonna be okay!?
lines.138: Yes...! Nisues made it in time.
lines.143: Thank goodness... If you need help with anything else--
lines.146: Ah, y-yeah... I mean, no, it's, um... uh...
lines.148: ...Thanks for saving me. W-well, I'll be going--!
lines.151: You're going to the Guild too. Let's go back together.
lines.154: N-no... I'm really fine! I'm used to being alone--!!
lines.157: ...It's all right. You'll get back safely.
lines.160: Don't worry. Neither Nisues nor anyone will be a burden.
lines.166: ...Um, is that okay? I'm, uh, well... honestly, I'm already--
lines.169: There's no reason to split up. You can at least keep watch on our rear, yeah?
lines.175: Nisues wants to hear your stories on the way. Will you tell her about being an adventurer?
lines.180: ...I'm fine now. Sorry... for making you waste time on someone like me--
lines.184: Nisues had fun. Will you teach her more next time?
lines.192: That person's aura was about to be crushed by anxiety. That isn't fun.
lines.195: --Everyone having fun. That's the best, isn't it?
lines.198: Next is reporting that the request is done, right? Will you watch to see if Nisues does it the right way?
lines.210: Yeah. She was really easy to work with. And she did the job carefully.
lines.213: ...She's a girl who really pays attention to those around her.
lines.217: Yes. But because of that, that child does not yet know herself.
lines.220: Someday, that child will melt someone's aura into her own and change herself. If she still does not know herself then, she cannot become a good Vesta.
lines.224: ...So basically, you want her to find something she loves?
lines.228: Champion. Please take care of that child.
lines.245: Nisues will try even harder from now on...!

2.title: What Does the Mirror of the Heart Reflect?
2.summary: After helping out in a chaotic kitchen, Nisues is asked by Stella what she herself wants to do, but can't think of anything on the spot and is thrown into confusion. So, as payment for her help, Nisues asks Alk and the others to help her search for "what she wants to do".

lines.9: Alk, the pot is about to boil over. May I stop it?
lines.13: Please! ...Agh, I don't have enough hands!
lines.17: An impatient aura. Is something wrong?
lines.21: We are preparing dinner. Today there is more than usual.
lines.30: ......No, I can only do odd jobs.
lines.35: Usually Shirano and the others help out too! But everyone's busy today!
lines.42: In the village, Nisues helped with cooking too. If she knows how to make it, she'll surely be useful.
lines.46: Th-thanks, that's a big help...!! Then take care of those ingredients! I'll start on the soup!
lines.51: Y-you're making even more...? It already looks like plenty.
lines.55: Hmm. Yeah, it is~. But if you're helping, Nisues, I thought we could do even more.
lines.58: If we're doing it anyway, it's nicer when everyone gets to eat something tasty, right?
lines.67: Understood...! Nisues will give it her all!
lines.79: Phew, thanks to you we made it in time... Thank you so much, Nisues.
lines.82: Let me help you with something next time. As thanks for today.
lines.87: No, it's all right. Everyone eating something tasty together. Nisues knows that's a happy thing.
lines.90: Nisues is the same as Alk. Everyone's joyful auras make Nisues happy, and it's fun.
lines.93: So that really makes Nisues happy.
lines.98: ......I see. So that's how it is for you, Nisues...
lines.101: In that sense, the difference for me is probably that it's my own cooking...
lines.105: ...What makes you happy, Nisues? What do you want to do?
lines.115: Stella isn't... worried about Nisues, is she...?
lines.118: She just... wants to know what Nisues wishes for...?
lines.132: S-sorry... Nisues can't think of anything all of a sudden-- N-Nisues isn't dissatisfied...!
lines.136: Adventuring life is fun too. But what Nisues wants to do...? Nisues is...? Wh-what is Nisues...?
lines.143: S-sorry, sorry...! That's not something you should force out!
lines.146: Well, if you think of anything, I'll always help. Just let me know whenever, okay?
lines.158: Sorry, did I keep you waiting?
lines.162: No...! Nisues is the one who called you...! Please, have a seat...!
lines.167: Nisues has been thinking since then. About what Nisues wants Alk and the others to help with--
lines.170: What makes Nisues happy. What she wants to do.
lines.182: Adventuring, playing, going to other worlds, even just helping out...
lines.189: And yet, Nisues can't answer Stella.
lines.193: ...I see. I don't think that's a bad thing, though.
lines.199: Even so, you want to know?
lines.205: Yes. So, Nisues has decided on her wish for your help.
lines.208: Nisues will search for Nisues. She wants you to help with that.
lines.213: ...You really, truly are serious, huh. It's my thanks, so of course I'll help.
lines.218: Then it is a treasure hunt.
lines.221: Let us look for the things you love.
lines.228: Nisues will do her utmost to find herself, for Stella and everyone too...!
lines.232: Hmm, she's serious to the core...

3.title: What She Found
3.summary: Visiting Voluntas Arcane Arts Academy on a delivery request, Nisues gets swept up by Golem Club members absorbed in what they love, and ends up half-forced into learning about golems. Through the experience of that study session, Nisues discovers what she wants to do.

lines.5: How about this? A delivery request.
lines.10: ......That's the Golem Club. This smells like trouble...
lines.15: From Voluntas Arcane Arts Academy. You know, that ridiculously grand castle-looking place--
lines.19: Arcane Arts Academy...? Does that mean a place where you can learn magic?
lines.24: Yeah. They research all kinds of magic, and you can take classes too, but...
lines.32: That's kind of unusual for you, huh?
lines.36: Alk, this is part of Nisues's "search for what she wants to do".
lines.39: Nisues can use magic too. But only Vesta magic.
lines.42: Nisues feels like gaining new knowledge will lead to finding what she wants to do...!
lines.51: Um... is that not very Nisues-like after all...?
lines.56: Nah, if anything I thought it was very you, in a good way.
lines.61: Alright, let's deliver it and take a look around while we're at it.
lines.73: So, after this is done, the club president is waiting on the field. He wants you to help test the newest model.
lines.75: Also, Professor Nicola asked me to tell Alk it's an emergency! He was kind of vague about what for, though--
lines.78: Sorry, Nisues. Mind if I go check on things for a bit?
lines.82: It's all right. Nisues is having fun looking around.
lines.85: Shut up!! How can you make golems without chasing romance!!!
lines.91: Anger-- but not only that? A very fun aura...?
lines.94: Um, why are you two fighting...?
lines.97: Hey, you look at this spell too! If you drive a golem with this, it's definitely gonna explode! Right!?!?
lines.99: No way! My spell is flawless! Theoretically it can hold right on the edge of exploding! You agree, right!?
lines.103: U-um... Nisues doesn't really understand spells and such...?
lines.106: You both feel you can't back down. That's why you're arguing.
lines.109: But why is it fun? Neither of your auras is even a little scary.
lines.112: F-fun...? Well, I guess, now that you mention it...?
lines.114: Well... if it weren't fun, we couldn't go at each other this hard, right?
lines.117: It's something you love, so it's fun... Anger and fear are part of it too--?
lines.125: Could it be-- you're interested in golems too!?
lines.129: Huh. Ah, no, Nisues is... just searching for what she wants to do--
lines.131: She was just curious about what you two love--
lines.134: Oh-ho! Is that so! Then why not try making a golem!?
lines.141: Right. In that case, golems it is.
lines.147: B-but, didn't you have work to do...!?
lines.157: ...So, this spell regulates the element's output. Like the heart in a living creature. Got it?
lines.173: --That's about how it goes. Any questions so far?
lines.178: Nisues has a question. How does this spell act on the golem's movement...?
lines.181: Ah, to be precise, this isn't part of the drive system, it's a control spell. In other words--
lines.201: Th-thank you so much...! It's all thanks to... everyone...?
lines.204: --S-sorry!! You must have been in the middle of important work...! N-Nisues got in the way--!
lines.207: It's fine, it's fine. It was a nice break for us too. Now, back to it...!
lines.209: What do you say? Want to stick around with us?
lines.227: I-I'm so sorry...! It was just a delivery, but Nisues made it take this long...
lines.231: Nah, no matter how you look at it, it's because Nicola came crying to us...
lines.236: But you really were super absorbed. I didn't expect the Golem Club, though.
lines.241: Did you find your treasure, Nisues?
lines.246: Did Nisues look like she was having fun?
lines.250: You looked like you were having fun.
lines.257: But learning something new. The golem moving. Nisues was happy.
lines.260: So Nisues must have found it...!
lines.269: Why not just join the Golem Club? I doubt they'd care that you're not a student. Memram would be surprised, though.
lines.278: Nah, it's fine, it's fine. Actually, I think she'd be impressed.
lines.282: ...I-if she's against it, Nisues wants you to help persuade her...!
